title: Sheinbaum to Attend World Cup Final; Trump Made the Invitation
author: Néstor Jiménez
content:
_This article by Néstor Jiménez originally appeared in the[July 17, 2026
edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/07/17/politica/sheinbaum-
asistira-a-final-de-la-copa-del-mundo-trump-realizo-la-invitacion), Mexico's
premier left wing daily newspaper._

President Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo will attend the FIFA World Cup final this
Sunday at the invitation of United States President Donald Trump, she
announced this Friday. In a brief interview at the conclusion of a handover of
property deeds as part of the Viviendas Bienestar (Wellbeing Housing) program
in Playa del Carmen, she noted that Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney will
also attend.

> "I received an invitation from President Trump to go to the World Cup final
> on Sunday. And I made the decision to go because, well, it is a direct
> invitation from the President of the United States. Prime Minister Carney
> will also be there," said the president.

She anticipated that tomorrow she will record a video to offer more details
about her trip, and noted that she expects to return to Mexico on Monday
morning.

**" We already reserved the tickets," she noted, hinting that she will travel
on a commercial flight, as she has done on international tours; nevertheless,
she did not clarify whether next Monday's "mañanera" will be held.**

With the change in her schedule, the president canceled the activities she had
planned for this Saturday and Sunday in Quintana Roo. Sheinbaum had
anticipated that she would hold a press conference on the sargassum on the
coasts of Quintana Roo. During the event she led today in Playa del Carmen,
she clarified that in 15 days a plan will be presented to address this
problem.
